scientific_integrity: Theorem analytically proved by an exact Laurent expansion and a global real-variable inequality; exact checker confirms symbolic identities and finite-alphabet equality cases. Independent mathematical and bibliographic validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Six fixed A2-root hexagonal frequencies with all coefficients unimodular; normalized sixth and fourth moments; finite grid conclusions require both side lengths at least seven; no generalizations to arbitrary coefficients, supports or other even moments.
title: Sharp sixth-moment range and sixth-root phase rigidity on the \(A_2\) Fourier hexagon
